name: p6_lem23_eq10
statement: (k a b : ℤ) : p6_kfib k a * p6_kfib k (b + 1) - p6_kfib k (a + 1) * p6_kfib k b = ((Int.negOnePow b : ℤˣ) : ℤ) * p6_kfib k (a - b)
closed: ∀ (k a b : ℤ), p6_kfib k a * p6_kfib k (b + 1) - p6_kfib k (a + 1) * p6_kfib k b = ((Int.negOnePow b : ℤˣ) : ℤ) * p6_kfib k (a - b)
informal: Lemma 2.3 (10) d'Ocagne: f_a f_{b+1} - f_{a+1} f_b = (-1)^b f_{a-b}
